t: You're looking at 1 to 11 Belgrave Square, a Grade I listed building in the City of Westminster. It's linked to Richard Tompkins, who lived here and died here in 1992. Born in 1918, he was a print, advertising and retail entrepreneur, best known for founding Green Shield Stamps and the Argos chain of catalogue stores. Argos grew into one of the largest retailers in the United Kingdom, and became part of the FTSE 100.
